baseline: Existing pinned 3.2.0 XGBoost environment; old state adapter byte-reproduction plus final causal double fit

candidates.family: Existing pinned MoE-XGBoost absolute-error recipe, end-known 120-day training; unchanged q baseline diagnostic

candidates.objective: L1 on (actual - rolling OOF C0)/3600; output max(0,C0+3600*correction)
Huber alpha=.9 on (actual - rolling OOF C0)/3600; exploratory central candidate evaluated by Q50 gates
quantile .5 on log((runtime+1)/(requested+1)); inverse max(0,exp(z)*(requested+1)-1); no smearing, no walltime cap

candidates.components: log1p runtime regressions on two historical groups; empirical log residual CDFs on internal last-7-day chronological block
candidates.early_label: FAILED OR duration<=300 seconds; historical label only
candidates.fit: gate and component training end-known before internal CDF block; residual labels end-known before model fit date; minimum 30 per component or candidate unavailable
candidates.gate: binary LightGBM on causal X; no hard branch
candidates.quantile: inf t>=0 such that p*F_short(t)+(1-p)*F_service(t)>=.5; 64 log-domain bisections; no component-mean mixing

candidates.family: one LightGBM binary model on expanded at-risk interval records
candidates.quantile: survival product of (1-h); uniform interpolation within finite interval, exponential beyond final edge
candidates.tail: exponential beyond last edge with mean observed training excess, or last-edge scale if no tail observations; quantile is not clipped to a walltime cap

candidates.no_available_component: exclude unavailable components by predeclared availability, not performance
candidates.weights: nonnegative sum1, sparse linear-program pinball objective on I1/I2 OOF predictions only; no hand weights

estimated_compute: single-thread deterministic fits, double refits; approximately 10-25 minutes on this host, no optimizer campaigns
invalid_requested_walltime: exclude from common scientific cohort and record; no physical cap invented
training_order: preregister commit, fit locked models/inner weights, commit model lock, open point holdout once
